entry.author: Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment
entry.summary:
The Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment, Simon Upton, submitted on the proposed Environment (Disestablishment of Ministry for the Environment) Amendment Bill to the Environment Select Committee. 
Read the report here: https://pce.parliament.nz/media/hozm552a/pce-submission-environment-disestablishment-of-mfe-amendment-bill_11-march-2026.pdf
